# Upgrading to the full pack

This lite pack is one effect (fire impact). The full **Elemental Impact VFX**
pack is the same system with six elements and the full texture set.

| | Lite (this) | Elemental Impact VFX |
|---|---|---|
| Effects | 1 (fire) | 6 (fire, ice, lightning, earth, wind, water) |
| Shape textures | 3 | 10 |
| System (shaders, ring, sparks, light) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Full source & presets | ✓ | ✓ |

The full pack ships under `addons/elemental_impacts/` (this one is
`addons/elemental_impacts_lite/`), so you can install both side by side. The
lite classes are `FreeElementalFx*`, the full ones are `ElementalFx*`.

Get it on the same store account.
